title: The fringe at each type's brows
description: Six hair styles composed by the game client on eight face types whose brows sit at different heights, before and after the fringe was given its own bone: from the front, three-quarter and from above, beside the reference.
target: A style's fringe ends just above the brows on every type, as it does on the reference; styles without a fringe keep a bare forehead (docs/CHARACTERS.md, The fringe per type).
